Author:     Magnus Melin <mkmelin+mozilla@iki.fi>
AuthorDate: Wed May 27 12:30:35 2026 +0300
Commit:     Magnus Melin <mkmelin+mozilla@iki.fi>
CommitDate: Wed May 27 12:30:35 2026 +0300

    Bug 2042676 - Port 1954004 to Thunderbird - Update builders to clang 21. r=john.bieling
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D302723

diff --git a/taskcluster/kinds/toolchain/clang.yml b/taskcluster/kinds/toolchain/clang.yml
index c3fda9523a9..a1e7e7849bb 100644
--- a/taskcluster/kinds/toolchain/clang.yml
+++ b/taskcluster/kinds/toolchain/clang.yml
@@ -32,10 +32,6 @@ linux64-clang-20:
         max-run-time: 600
     run:
         script: repack-clang.sh
-        toolchain-alias:
-            by-project:
-                toolchains: null
-                default: linux64-clang
         toolchain-artifact: public/build/clang.tar.zst
     fetches:
         toolchain:
@@ -50,12 +46,12 @@ linux64-clang-20:
             - win64-aarch64-compiler-rt-20
             - win64-compiler-rt-20
 
-win64-clang-20:
-    description: "Clang-cl 20 toolchain build"
+linux64-clang-21:
+    description: "Clang 21 toolchain build"
     attributes:
         local-toolchain: true
     treeherder:
-        symbol: TW64(clang-20)
+        symbol: TL(clang-21)
     worker:
         max-run-time: 600
     run:
@@ -63,9 +59,31 @@ win64-clang-20:
         toolchain-alias:
             by-project:
                 toolchains: null
-                default:
-                    - win64-clang
-                    - win64-clang-toolchain
+                default: linux64-clang
+        toolchain-artifact: public/build/clang.tar.zst
+    fetches:
+        toolchain:
+            - linux64-cctools-port
+            - linux64-clang-21-raw
+            - linux64-aarch64-compiler-rt-21
+            - linux64-x64-compiler-rt-21
+            - macosx64-aarch64-compiler-rt-21
+            - macosx64-x64-compiler-rt-21
+            - wasm32-wasi-compiler-rt-21
+            - win32-compiler-rt-21
+            - win64-aarch64-compiler-rt-21
+            - win64-compiler-rt-21
+
+win64-clang-20:
+    description: "Clang-cl 20 toolchain build"
+    attributes:
+        local-toolchain: true
+    treeherder:
+        symbol: TW64(clang-20)
+    worker:
+        max-run-time: 600
+    run:
+        script: repack-clang.sh
         toolchain-artifact: public/build/clang.tar.zst
     fetches:
         toolchain:
@@ -79,3 +97,33 @@ win64-clang-20:
             - win32-compiler-rt-20
             - win64-aarch64-compiler-rt-20
             - win64-compiler-rt-20
+
+win64-clang-21:
+    description: "Clang-cl 21 toolchain build"
+    attributes:
+        local-toolchain: true
+    treeherder:
+        symbol: TW64(clang-21)
+    worker:
+        max-run-time: 600
+    run:
+        script: repack-clang.sh
+        toolchain-alias:
+            by-project:
+                toolchains: null
+                default:
+                    - win64-clang
+                    - win64-clang-toolchain
+        toolchain-artifact: public/build/clang.tar.zst
+    fetches:
+        toolchain:
+            - linux64-cctools-port
+            - win64-clang-21-raw
+            - linux64-aarch64-compiler-rt-21
+            - linux64-x64-compiler-rt-21
+            - macosx64-aarch64-compiler-rt-21
+            - macosx64-x64-compiler-rt-21
+            - wasm32-wasi-compiler-rt-21
+            - win32-compiler-rt-21
+            - win64-aarch64-compiler-rt-21
+            - win64-compiler-rt-21

+    - macosx64-clang-21-stage2

@@ -69,6 +79,7 @@ reference-tasks:
     - macosx64-sdk
     - macosx64-sdk-toolchain
     - macosx64-x64-compiler-rt-20
+    - macosx64-x64-compiler-rt-21
     - mingw32-rust
     - node-modules
     - nsis
@@ -80,18 +91,25 @@ reference-tasks:
     - vs
     - wasm32-wasi-compiler-rt-19
     - wasm32-wasi-compiler-rt-20
+    - wasm32-wasi-compiler-rt-21
     - win32-compiler-rt-20
+    - win32-compiler-rt-21
     - win32-fix-stacks
     - win32-minidump-stackwalk
     - win32-node
     - win64-7zz
     - win64-aarch64-compiler-rt-20
+    - win64-aarch64-compiler-rt-21
     - win64-cbindgen
     - win64-clang-20-profile
     - win64-clang-20-raw
     - win64-clang-20-stage2
+    - win64-clang-21-profile
+    - win64-clang-21-raw
+    - win64-clang-21-stage2
     - win64-cmake
     - win64-compiler-rt-20

     - win64-dump_syms
